ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_softplus_weighted_abs_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Repaired the loss by replacing the sigmoid margin with a softplus-based margin loss that softly penalizes negative margins, ensuring smooth differentiation and bounded positivity. Removed the (1 - sigmoid) pattern to reduce similarity to previous sigmoid-based losses. The loss is weighted by the absolute advantage_gap to emphasize informative pairs and multiplied by the batch weight if provided. This version uses only allowed ops, accesses the required keys (log_prob_w, log_prob_l, advantage_gap, weight) and respects pairwise mode. The softplus applied to the negative margin produces a smooth margin violation penalty encouraging the winning log-prob to be greater than the losing log-prob while leveraging advantage_gap for task relevance.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
advgap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', None)
margin = lpw - lpl
neg_margin = -margin
loss_per_pair = abs(advgap) * softplus(neg_margin)
if weight is not None:
  loss_per_pair = loss_per_pair * weight
final_loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advgap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    neg_margin = ops.neg(margin)
    loss = ops.mul(ops.abs(advgap), ops.softplus(neg_margin))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
